id: \bI stole this when they weren't looking. I think they are onto me though. Slip it out for me, will you?
en: \bI stole this when they weren't looking. I think they are onto me though. Slip it out for me, will you?
it: \bL'ho rubato mentre non guardavano. Però credo che mi abbiano scoperto. Portalo fuori tu per me, va bene?
